description: This file declares the CrosvmBuilder class used to construct and configure crosvm virtual machine instances, including methods to add CPUs, disks, networking, serial ports, and other virtual hardware components. It serves as an interface for building crosvm commands programmatically within the project.

classes.name: CrosvmBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing and configuring crosvm virtual machine commands, providing methods to add hardware components, network sockets, disks, and manage the VM process.

methods.name: ApplyProcessRestarter
methods.description: Configures the process restarter with the crosvm binary path, initial arguments, and exit code.

methods.name: AddControlSocket
methods.description: Adds a control socket to the crosvm launch configuration.

methods.name: AddCpus
methods.description: Adds a specified number of CPUs to the VM, with options for configuration paths or JSON values.

methods.name: AddHvcReadOnly
methods.description: Adds an HVC device in read-only mode.

methods.name: AddHvcReadWrite
methods.description: Adds an HVC device with read-write permissions.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadOnly
methods.description: Adds a serial console in read-only mode.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a serial console in read-write mode.

methods.name: AddVhostUser
methods.description: Adds a vhost-user device for high-performance device passthrough.

methods.name: HvcNum
methods.description: Returns the number of HVC devices added.

methods.name: Cmd
methods.description: Returns a reference to the command object used to build the crosvm invocation.
